chapter_title: Chemistry of Benzene: Electrophilic Aromatic Substitution

questions.chapter_title: Chemistry of Benzene: Electrophilic Aromatic Substitution
questions.question: Which 2-step sequence converts benzene into meta-bromonitrobenzene?
questions.correct_answer: 1. HNO3, H2SO4 (nitration); 2. Br2, FeBr3 (bromination)
questions.explanation: Nitration installs the meta-directing nitro group first, directing subsequent bromination to the meta position.

questions.chapter_title: Chemistry of Benzene: Electrophilic Aromatic Substitution
questions.question: Which 2-step sequence converts benzene into para-bromonitrobenzene?

options.label: C
options.text: 1. Br2, FeBr3 (bromination); 2. HNO3, H2SO4 (nitration, separate para isomer)

questions.correct_answer: 1. Br2, FeBr3 (bromination); 2. HNO3, H2SO4 (nitration, separate para isomer)
questions.explanation: Bromination installs an ortho/para director first, directing subsequent nitration to the para position.

questions.chapter_title: Chemistry of Benzene: Electrophilic Aromatic Substitution
questions.question: Which sequence converts benzene into pure propylbenzene (PhCH2CH2CH3) without isopropylbenzene byproduct?

options.label: A
options.text: 1. Propanoyl chloride, AlCl3 (Friedel-Crafts acylation); 2. Zn(Hg), HCl (Clemmensen reduction)

questions.correct_answer: 1. Propanoyl chloride, AlCl3 (Friedel-Crafts acylation); 2. Zn(Hg), HCl (Clemmensen reduction)
questions.explanation: Acylation avoids carbocation rearrangement; subsequent Clemmensen reduction reduces the ketone to methylene.

questions.chapter_title: Chemistry of Benzene: Electrophilic Aromatic Substitution
questions.question: Which sequence converts toluene into para-nitrobenzoic acid?

options.label: B
options.text: 1. HNO3, H2SO4 (nitration, isolate para isomer); 2. KMnO4, H2O, heat (side-chain oxidation)

questions.correct_answer: 1. HNO3, H2SO4 (nitration, isolate para isomer); 2. KMnO4, H2O, heat (side-chain oxidation)
questions.explanation: Toluene's methyl group directs nitration ortho/para; subsequent oxidation converts the methyl to benzoic acid.

questions.chapter_title: Chemistry of Benzene: Electrophilic Aromatic Substitution
questions.question: Which sequence converts toluene into meta-nitrobenzoic acid?

options.label: A
options.text: 1. KMnO4, H2O, heat (oxidize to benzoic acid); 2. HNO3, H2SO4 (nitration directed meta)

questions.correct_answer: 1. KMnO4, H2O, heat (oxidize to benzoic acid); 2. HNO3, H2SO4 (nitration directed meta)
questions.explanation: Oxidizing methyl to carboxyl (-COOH) creates a meta-director prior to nitration.

questions.chapter_title: Chemistry of Benzene: Electrophilic Aromatic Substitution
questions.question: Which sequence converts benzene into para-chloroaniline?

options.label: B
options.text: 1. Cl2, FeCl3; 2. HNO3, H2SO4; 3. H2, Pd

options.label: D
options.text: 1. HNO3, H2SO4; 2. Fe, HCl (reduce to aniline); 3. Ac2O (protect); 4. Cl2, FeCl3; 5. H3O+, heat (deprotect)

questions.correct_answer: 1. HNO3, H2SO4; 2. Fe, HCl (reduce to aniline); 3. Ac2O (protect); 4. Cl2, FeCl3; 5. H3O+, heat (deprotect)
questions.explanation: Acetylation protects the amino group and tempers its reactivity, preventing polyhalogenation during chlorination.
